name: ac-portfolio-financing
description: How private fund positions are financed and how LPs get liquidity: subscription lines and their effect on reported returns, NAV loans and asset-based facilities, continuation funds and GP-led secondaries, LP-led secondaries and their discounts, conflicts of interest in a continuation, fund-level leverage and its cost, and the written financing record. It explains the mechanics and the conflicts; it never recommends a fund and never predicts a discount. Use when asking "subscription line", "NAV loan", "continuation fund", "GP-led secondary", "LP secondary", "fund-level leverage", "IRR inflation", "should I roll into the continuation vehicle". Not for the manager's operations and terms (ac-manager-and-vehicle-diligence), not for private credit as an asset class (ac-private-credit), not for the allocation decision (ac-alternatives-and-real-assets).
